svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Halo bridge breadboard wiring
svg.desc: ESP32-C3 Super Mini and ESP32-S3 Super Mini on a half size breadboard: C3 GPIO8 to S3 GPIO2, S3 GPIO1 to C3 GPIO7, 5V to 5V, GND to GND. (c) 2026 espboards.dev. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
svg.text: Both boards face up, USB to the left. Each wire sits in the same column as its pin.

g.data-note: GPIO, ADC pin, SPI Master In Slave Out, PWM
GPIO, SPI Master Out Slave In, PWM

svg.text: Plug in one USB cable at a time: either board powers both through the 5V wire.
No reset wire: the S3 Super Mini has no EN pin on its edge.
C3 GPIO8 also drives its blue LED, so the LED flickers with serial traffic.
